sourceReceipts.conditions: Vals Harvey LAB v1 held-out cohort, updated 2026-10-07. Harvey generation/grading protocol; internet disabled; Read File, Edit File, Write File, Glob, Bash, Grep and docx/pptx/xlsx skills. Two judge task pass rates are averaged; each task passes only when every rubric criterion passes. Judges: GPT 5.5 medium reasoning and Claude Sonnet 4.6. Vals model library/Valkyrie harness; tracked-change grading fix; prompt caching changes.
caveats: Published operator results; no model or judge inference was run for this import.
Runtime model access, API availability, and equivalence to a local rerun are unconfirmed.
The source label and reported configuration are retained; similarly named model generations and effort variants are not aliased.
Held-out results cannot be reproduced from the open public LAB set alone.
The embedded metadata marks dataset_type public, while the visible benchmark text explicitly says these results use the held-out set; held-out prose governs this receipt.
Criterion pass rate is a different metric and is not imported.
Claude Fable 5 reported task pass rate includes Opus 4.8 fallback on four tasks and is ineligible for a single-model composite.
Kimi K3 is 12.92% in both the table and embedded numeric data; prose elsewhere says 10.83%, so the table is used.

identityPolicy: Slug lowercase labels, encode literal plus signs as -plus-, replace every remaining non-ASCII-alphanumeric run with hyphen, trim hyphens. Exact displayed labels remain distinct; duplicate Grok display labels add URL-verified High reasoning/Low reasoning suffixes. No semantic model aliases.
providerGroupingCaveat: Open models is a broad UI group for non-primary model families and hosted open-family models; it is not a verified statement of downloadable weights or licensing. Native provider/source identity is retained per row.
